title: Catch Up · skills for adders
intro: Short retrieval tasks from earlier lessons. Choose these if you need to revisit the foundations before practising adders.

items.title: XOR from earlier logic work
items.prompt: For input pairs 00, 01, 10, 11, write the XOR outputs in order. Explain when XOR outputs 1.
items.answer: 0, 1, 1, 0. XOR is 1 when the inputs are different.
steps: Compare the two inputs for each row.
When exactly one is 1, XOR outputs 1.

items.title: AND and binary carry
items.prompt: Write the AND outputs for 00, 01, 10, 11. Then calculate 1 + 1 in binary.
steps: AND is 1 only if both inputs are 1.
In binary 1+1 gives a 0 in the current column and carries a 1 into the next.

items.title: Link to Lesson 029 simplification
items.prompt: Simplify the Boolean expression (A ∧ B) ∨ (A ∧ ¬B). State the rule you use.
items.answer: A. Factorise as A ∧ (B ∨ ¬B) = A ∧ 1 = A.
steps: Take out the common factor A.
B OR NOT B is always 1.
